title: E0100: Variable Function Call
plain_english: Calling a function using a name that comes from user input can allow an attacker to invoke arbitrary PHP functions on your server.
why_matters: Variable function calls allow dynamic code execution when the function name is controllable by an attacker: - Arbitrary PHP functions can be called - Dangerous system functions like `system()`, `exec()`, or `shell_exec()` may be reachable - Access controls may be bypassed
what_it_checks: `$func()` where `$func` is assigned from tainted superglobals
